explication: Checkout is a GitHub Action that reads workflow inputs, validates checkout settings, obtains repository content, and places the requested revision in the workspace. Its main source-provider orchestrates repository preparation, Git fetch/checkout, and API archive fallback; credentials and post-job cleanup are separate concerns. The README documents sparse checkout, partial clone, LFS, submodules, and credential persistence. Some feature implementations were not excerpted, so links rely on the source index or README where supported.
